data.narrative:
Retro Biosciences is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Joe Betts-LaCroix that has raised $180M to date. The valuation analysis references a peer universe of 3 public companies in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage comparables including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses the $180M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A-to-next-stage progression, yielding $360M. The Peer-Median approach was not viable due to insufficient narrow-filter matches within the same stage and valuation tier (0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage peers identified). Public-Comp Anchoring could not be executed because the target's revenue is not publicly available, a constraint common to private companies; the sector median P/S of 9.2x across the three public biotech names provides context but cannot be applied without revenue data.

The triangulated range is $306M to $414M, with a median of $360M supported by the single applicable method. Key uncertainties center on the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for this specific company and stage, the absence of revenue-based valuation approaches, and limited narrow peer comparability within the Biotech & Health sector at Series A.
